units.source_text: 秋好皇后读了，知道这是去年所赠红叶诗的答复，脸上显出笑容。

en.t: When Empress Akikonomu read it, she realized that it was a reply to the poem about autumn leaves she had sent the year before, and a smile appeared on her face.

units.source_text: 昨日被紫姬邀去游船的众侍女，真心赞佩春花，互相告道：

en.t: The gentlewomen who had been invited by Lady Murasaki to go boating the day before sincerely admired the spring blossoms and said to one another:

units.source_text: “原来春色如此美丽，只怕娘娘也不得不赞赏呢。”

en.t: So spring scenery is this beautiful; surely even Her Majesty cannot help admiring it.
